proof_idea: The CPMM floor theorem uses Nat.div_mul_le_self and Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul to characterize floor(num / den) by adjacent integer ticks.
The route theorem uses induction over vertex lists. Each edge certificate rate(u,v) * potential(v) <= potential(u) composes multiplicatively, with nonnegative rates preserving order.
scope_limits: This proves the abstract route-interval graph certificate shape, not production router optimality.
It assumes externally supplied nonnegative upper rates and positive potentials.
It does not model live reserve mutation, concurrency, MEV ordering, or external venue execution.
